verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI (npm i -g @stripe/cli) for building, testing, and managing integrations from the command line. It is explicitly framed as agent-ready tooling: `stripe agent setup` auto-configures coding agents, and `stripe sandbox create` lets coding agents provision keyless sandboxes. Machine-readable output (`stripe directory search --format json`) and a companion Link CLI with `--llms-full` and `--schema` show agent-legible design. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
Coding agents should install the Stripe CLI (npm i -g @stripe/cli) and run the command stripe sandbox create --help to provision an anonymous Stripe sandbox with working API keys.
Agent setup: Automatically configure your agent coding harness for Stripe
Your agent can inspect the full CLI documentation with `link-cli --llms-full`, and the current input contract for any command with `link-cli <command> --schema`.
